samples.summary: `NO_DATE` is a new `export` that nothing outside its own file imports — knip's unused-exports gate should flag it
samples.evidence: Repo-wide grep for `NO_DATE` returns only packages/frontend/src/app/documents/document-list-utils.ts:76, :81, :112, :127 — all inside the declaring file. knip.json (root) registers packages/frontend with entry `src/main.tsx` + `tests/**/*.test.ts`; document-list-utils.ts is not an entry, and the new test file imports `formatExactDate`/`formatFullDateTime`/`formatListDate` but never `NO_DATE` (tests/app/documents/document-list-utils.test.ts:6-9). Fix belongs on the new code: drop the `export`, or use the constant from the tests instead of the literal "—".

samples.summary: Other date renderers across the frontend still hard-code relative time and silently ignore the new user preference
samples.evidence: `formatRelativeTime` from the same module is still called unconditionally at packages/frontend/src/app/files/generic-file-view.tsx:41 and packages/frontend/src/components/notifications/notification-item.tsx:47, and packages/frontend/src/app/datasources/datasource-list.tsx:160 calls `formatDistanceToNow` directly. The Settings copy says "How the Modified and Created columns are shown in document lists", so this may be intentional scoping, but the datasources list is also a document-ish list with a relative-time column that will now disagree with the documents list. None of these sites gained a tooltip with the full timestamp either.

samples.summary: Two different `formatRelativeTime` implementations now coexist; the Settings preview advertises only one of them
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/lib/utils.ts:16 exports a *different* `formatRelativeTime` ("3m ago"/"3d ago" style) used by the comment components (CommentThreadCard.tsx:13/:103, CommentSidePanel.tsx:5/:107, OrphanedCard.tsx:3/:42), while Settings previews the date-fns variant from @/app/documents/document-list-utils. A user who picks a format in Settings will see comment timestamps that follow neither the preview nor the preference.

samples.summary: The `storage` subscription is not key-filtered, so unrelated cross-tab writes re-render every date cell
samples.evidence: `subscribe` registers `onChange` for all `storage` events. Other modules write localStorage from other tabs — packages/frontend/src/app/board/board-grid.ts:232/:262, packages/frontend/src/app/slides/slides-view.tsx:992/:1003, packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-settings.ts:24, packages/frontend/src/api/analytics.ts:53 — each of which will now wake every mounted `DateCell`. Snapshot equality keeps it a no-op re-render, so impact is small; filtering on `e.key === STORAGE_KEY || e.key === null` would be tidier.

samples.summary: The new test deletes `window.matchMedia` in `afterAll`, and its premise that jsdom ships none is questionable
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/tests/components/theme-provider.test.tsx:15-31 comments "jsdom ships no matchMedia" and `Reflect.deleteProperty(window, "matchMedia")` at afterAll. jsdom does implement `window.matchMedia`, and packages/frontend/tests/setup.ts (which polyfills ResizeObserver and Blob.arrayBuffer but not matchMedia) suggests other component tests rely on jsdom's built-in. Vitest's default per-file isolation contains the deletion, so this only bites if isolation is ever turned off in vite.config.ts (test block at :266-271).
